t: The tall building in front of you is Chapter Spitalfields, a 33-storey student tower at 9 Frying Pan Alley. It was originally called Nido Spitalfields, and it is one of the tallest student residences in the world. It stands in Tower Hamlets, right beside the boundary with the City of London, which runs along Middlesex Street, part of the Petticoat Lane Market area. The architect given for it is Thomas Bennett, though he is better known for his work on the new towns of Crawley and Stevenage.
